en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a ceremonial scene on a balcony of an old building. Three men in military and formal attire stand behind a draped balustrade, flanked by large flags. Above the balcony is a decorative star made of wreaths or garlands. A person looks out from an upper window to the left. Handwritten annotations include a date at the top and writing along the left edge and bottom, suggesting the location and event.
